results.content:
Different question, and worth answering briefly.  
  
The main alternatives to NX as a CAD system are CATIA for aerospace and automotive surfacing, SOLIDWORKS for mechanical design at mid-market scale, and Creo for engineering-heavy discrete manufacturing. Onshape is the cloud-native option, lighter than all three.  
  
Changing CAD is a much larger decision than changing PLM. It affects every engineer daily, it means retraining, and legacy models do not translate cleanly between systems. Most organizations that consider it conclude the disruption is not worth it unless a customer mandate forces the change. [...] NX is Siemens' CAD system, used for mechanical design, surfacing, simulation and CAM. It competes with CATIA, SOLIDWORKS and Creo.  
  
Teamcenter is Siemens' PLM platform. It manages what happens to the data NX produces: part numbering, revisions, BOM structures, change circuits, configuration management, manufacturing process planning. It competes with Windchill, ENOVIA and Aras.  
  
The two are sold together often enough that people treat them as one product. They are not, and the practical consequence matters: you can change your PLM without changing your CAD. Teams running NX are not obliged to run Teamcenter, and a modern PLM connects to NX natively. [...] Worth knowing: if the reason you are considering an NX alternative is cost or rigidity in how your product data is managed, that is a PLM problem rather than a CAD problem, and it is solvable without touching the CAD.

 Remote caching
 Distributing tasks across different machines
 Controlling testing so only code impacted by a PR is tested

And many more.

## Nx vs. similar tools

Alternatives to Nx include Rush Stack, Lerna, Turborepo, and Yarn Workspaces: [...] | Turborepo | A monorepo management tool that aims to maximize running speed for tasks and build times in your web projects | Was acquired by Vercel in recent years | Web applications | A highly efficient caching mechanism that it uses when running tasks; CI integrations; multiple ways to optimize your project’s builds and caching |
| Yarn Workspaces | A package management tool that helps you optimize the ways packages are installed and shared in a monorepo project | Web applications | Doesn’t have the higher level tools like Rush Stack or Nx, but provides a common set of commands that allow you to efficiently manage package installations and dependencies in your web projects | [...] Looking back at our project, you’ll now see `inventory` and `inventory-e2e` projects alongside our `react-monorepo` and `react-monorepo-e2e` projects:
